info.longName: Amplify Etho Climate Leadership U.S. ETF

funds_data.description: The index tracks the performance of the equity securities of a diversified set of U.S. companies that are leaders in their industry with respect to their carbon impact. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. companies that are leaders in their industry with respect to their carbon impact. The fund is non-diversified.
